name: integrate-egma
description: Integrate Egma into a repository containing voice agent code. Use when the developer asks to integrate voice agent testing, monitoring or both

findings.excerpt: Use `npx skills update integrate-egma` to update the project/global version of this skill installed on the developer's machine.
